To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
there are four main challenges in social media analytics, namely, data discovery, data collection and preparation, as well as data analysis.
there is an urgent need for the development of a framework for the collection and analysis of social media data.
the most important challenges in the social media analytics process, data discovery, data collection and data preparation, are the volume of data, data heterogeneity and data quality.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the most important challenges in the social media analytics process.
identifying the challenges in the data discovery, collection and preparation stages of social media analytics.
the identification of challenges and solutions for the social media analytics process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the volume of social media data is a challenge that is not easy to solve, but that there are solutions available that can be applied in different situations.
social media analytics is still an emerging field with a lot of potential and challenges.
the literature on social media analytics is very heterogeneous.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
social media analytics is not just a data analysis problem, but also a data collection and preparation problem.
the volume of social media data is a challenge that needs to be addressed.
social media analysis is not only about analysing data but also about collecting data and preparing it for analysis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
researchers need to consider a number of challenges when collecting social media data.
the volume of social media data is the most important challenge in the social media analytics process.
researchers and practitioners should be aware of the challenges and difficulties involved in the social media analytics process.
